maddeler.e:
احتشيت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَشَيْتُ (iḥtašaytu) /iħ.ta.ʃaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# اِحْتَشَيْتَ (iḥtašayta) /iħ.ta.ʃaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# اِحْتَشَيْتِ (iḥtašayti) /iħ.ta.ʃaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# اُحْتُشِيتُ (uḥtušītu) /uħ.tu.ʃiː.tu/: first-person singular
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
